::: {.why}
Stating the procedure first is what makes the multiple-testing correction honest, and it is the difference between milestone 3 being research and being a story.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State your selection procedure completely enough that someone else could run it and get your pairs.
- Report the number of pairs screened and the correction that number implies for the strategy's eventual Sharpe.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>55 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Implement the rule as qlib/signals/pairs.py: a function taking a universe and a formation window and returning the selected pairs with their hedge ratios. No parameters chosen by looking at trading results. Log the screen count to research_log.jsonl automatically.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Run it on the formation period only, which must end before the trading period begins, and record the selected pairs, the screen count and the implied deflated-Sharpe hurdle at that count. Put all three on the first page of reports/milestone-03-pairs.md.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
qlib/signals/pairs.py holds the pair selection rule, fixed in code before any trading result exists, with its screen count logged automatically. The hurdle that count implies is on the first page of the milestone rather than in a footnote.
:::
